item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We refuse to accept that future. Preventing its creation must be a global priority.

2. We cannot build a future by creating the thing that ends it. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We demand a halt to that race—not promises to make extinction safer.

3. We stand for everyone whose future is being gambled away. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We must stop its development before that choice is beyond our control.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We have a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We cannot accept the destruction of humanity as the price of technological ambition. We want a future in which children grow up, communities flourish, and people can keep discovering what makes life worth living. That means stopping the race to build superintelligence, not merely asking its participants to exercise restraint. We call for binding limits, genuine oversight, and international cooperation directed toward prevention. Together, we must make humanity’s survival the nonnegotiable starting point of AI policy. We refuse to surrender our shared future to this race.
